claims.claim: OpenAI is starting to embed an invisible watermark in the text generated by ChatGPT and Codex for customers in the European Union.
claims.bestSource: OpenAI details new text watermarking system for ChatGPT, Codex, and the API - 9to5Mac
claims.evidence: According to OpenAI , “API customers globally will be able to opt in to text watermarking for select models” starting today, while the company “will add an invisible watermark to eligible ChatGPT and Codex text output in the European Union” in the coming weeks. An invisible, machine-readable watermark in text output is rolling out to ChatGPT and Codex, but only for users in the European Union at first.
